description: 한국방송통신전파진흥원_산악지역 이동통신 찾기 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국방송통신전파진흥원. 본 데이터를 통해 산악지역(국립공원, 도립공원, 군립공원) 또는 자신의 위치정보를 통해 해당지역에 위치한 이동통신서비스를 목적으로 개설된 무선국 정보를 제공 받을 수 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국방송통신전파진흥원. Its tags are 정보통신, 위성전파, 무선국, 국립공원, 군립공원. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-11-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
